prompts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Edit target is the stone bridge source, supporting reference is station-palms, final scene is composition reference only. Create one coherent exceptionally detailed hand-painted Vietnamese heritage illustration cutout of the EMPTY stone railway viaduct connecting to the village station and its solid landscaped platform on the right. Genuine transparent background, no lake, sky or distant landscape, NO TRAIN, NO SMOKE, NO TEXT.
Canvas very wide landscape approximately 2400 by 900. Railway runs straight diagonally down to the right in projection, NOT a physically steep hill: common projected near rail approximately from (0,220) to (2400,580), slope 0.15, smooth absolutely straight uninterrupted continuous two steel rails, correctly spaced brown wooden sleepers and gravel bed. Railway must run cleanly OFF BOTH left and right canvas edges, no isolated floating cut-off entry on left. On left 62% seven or eight modest rounded sandstone arches with structurally thick piers and dark soffits, transition on right into solid stone retaining embankment and station platform, with shrubs supporting the base. No fence across train track.
Station on right roughly x1450 to2090, behind railway at correct scale. One small Vietnamese heritage station: warm plaster walls, terracotta tiled roof, right gable visible, veranda faces the railway toward viewer. Strong coherent architectural perspective: front facade, ridge, eaves, veranda floor and platform length all parallel the same rail direction (down right); upright columns; right-gable depth edges recede away/up-right consistently. Veranda roof and pitched main roof have physically sensible distinct planes. House has clear grounded foundation on a level platform behind and alongside the rails, solid stone platform face and shaded veranda feet, no building hovering over arches. Palm trees behind and right; subtle red flowering shrubs. Foreground of viaduct must not become excessively bushy and obscure arches. Match the source illustration's sophisticated jade/gold/cream/red painted detail. Orthographic-like distant slightly elevated three-quarter camera, consistent for bridge AND station. Keep bridge rail and house in ONE shared viewpoint. Soft warm daylight from upper left. All desired art fits vertically with transparent surrounding space. Rails extend to both horizontal edges, no white rectangle or paper plate. Preserve original visual character and main proportions of the scene reference.

Use case: precise-object-edit / compositing. Image 1 is the shared fixed railway-station camera guide; image 2 is the train design to preserve. Create ONLY a complete steam train cutout on genuine transparent background with no scenery, track, shadows extending beyond wheels, or smoke. Locomotive faces RIGHT, on right end, pulling FOUR passenger coaches to its left: rear red, then dark blue, then green, then red coach next to locomotive. Match the red/gold painted heritage style and compact realistic proportions of image 2, with carefully drawn wheels, couplers, running gear and black iron undercarriage. Do NOT add any extra coach or turn engine left.
CRITICAL CAMERA: The train must have the EXACT SAME projected viewing direction as image 1's straight railway. A slightly elevated distant three-quarter view. All visible near wheel contact points must lie on ONE absolutely straight line descending right with slope +0.227 (approximately 12.8 degrees clockwise). Rearmost near wheel near x100,y180; foremost near wheel near x2250,y668 on a roughly 2400x800 canvas. This incline is screen perspective; body verticals stay upright. Wheels realistic circles/ellipses consistent with view, roofs, floorboards, windows share same projected rail direction. Make rear car slightly smaller than front, but never stepped baselines, floating wheels, doubled wheels or disconnected couplings. Every wheel rim tangent to the common ground line. Train alone, no drawn guide line or rails.
Engine about 22% of complete train length, four coaches remaining 78%. Locomotive boiler horizontal ALONG the projected railway, red cylindrical boiler with gold bands and black wheels/gold rims. The functional black flared smokestack is at the FRONT of boiler, near right end behind brass front face, approximately 94% of total train width. One main smoke chimney, small brass steam domes farther rear on boiler; no smoke baked in. Front red cowcatcher just above wheel contact line, not hanging below rail. No giant locomotive, no toy plastic finish. Beautiful painterly microdetail, warm natural upper-left light, jade/gold Vietnamese illustrated website, no text or logos. Train fills wide canvas, fully visible end to end. Keep cutout alpha clean.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this train cutout. Change ONLY the locomotive smokestack arrangement: REMOVE the tall black chimney directly in front of the driver's cab, replace that position with a low rounded brass steam dome. Put the ONE tall BLACK flared smoke chimney at the FRONT of the boiler just BEHIND the round brass front face on the RIGHT (replace the tall brass chimney near right front with the BLACK flared smoke chimney). The ONE true chimney must be on the right-front boiler, as in a real steam locomotive. The small brass steam domes stay low in the rear half of boiler. No smoke baked in. All other train geometry, 4 coach colors/order, couplers, windows, wheels, wheel contact baseline, camera angle, painterly style and transparent background MUST remain the same. Do NOT reshape or reframe the whole train. Keep the full train visible with true transparent alpha.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the station building architecture and its veranda on this transparent bridge-and-station cutout. Preserve the railway, every rail pixel/direction, stone arches, left entrance, platform retaining walls, palms, shrubs, lighting, image size, transparency and composition unchanged.
The current roof ridge and veranda eaves are nearly horizontal, causing a perspective mismatch. CORRECT the HOUSE LONGITUDINAL LINES so they descend to the right at the same projected +0.227 slope (~12.8 degrees) as the railway and platform front. Redraw the pitched roof, veranda roof, windows, door lintels and sills on that architectural system. Keep vertical columns and wall corners upright, not rotated. This is changing the camera perspective of the HOUSE, not rotating the whole cutout. Long facade faces rails/viewer, right gable visible. Shared weak perspective / distant orthographic view.
On the approximately 2048x768 source canvas, coherent desired anchors are main roof ridge left (1390,205) to right (1750,287); veranda front eaves left (1190,340) to right (1620,438), veranda front ground left (1190,440) to right (1620,538). All these long lines parallel the rail. Short gable/depth lines recede upward-right. Leave platform edge and rails unchanged; veranda feet must meet platform. Fit this into the existing station area, same size/scale, warm plaster, rich red tile, palms right. Show physically clear support and warm contact shadow under each column. No extra track, no train, no smoke, no text, no new background. Genuine transparent background.

Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a transparent railway viaduct and station cutout. Make ONE precise proportion correction: reduce the station BUILDING to 75% of its present width and height, scaling around its front-left veranda foot (approximately source x1200,y430). Its left-front veranda foot stays planted there. The building therefore ends farther left than it currently does. Reduce the palm tree group to 80% of its current size while keeping its roots on the right bank, so palms remain behind/right of the smaller station. Replace newly exposed space with subtle low shrubs and visible empty stone station platform, no paper or color background.
KEEP ALL of the railway, rails, sleepers, stone viaduct arches, bridge entrance at left, platform front wall, track centerline and image canvas geometry EXACTLY unchanged. Keep the house's CORRECT shared perspective: its roof ridge, long front eaves and front facade descend right parallel to the +0.23 rail direction; vertical columns remain upright; right gable visible; warm plaster, red tiles, front veranda faces the rails. This is making the building smaller in the existing correct camera, NOT changing camera, NOT tilting or flattening roof perspective. Preserve clear foot shadows and real platform support.
The smaller station should feel like an intimate village stop in a grand landscape, with clear breathing room between train and station and more visible landscape behind. No train, no smoke, no text. Preserve genuine transparent alpha; no sky, lake, rectangle or haze background. Same image canvas and composition, same fine painted detail and warm lighting.
